basis: muxui:decision:0022:amendment:01: retroactive independent review of the current code for the R1.2 families
claimBoundary: findings is not a pass. clear means the reviewer found nothing within the stated lenses, files, tests, and probes; it is not proof of correctness. A fixed resolution means a fix merged in pull request #204 with tests that fail without it; independent reviewers verified those tests on the pull-request branch before merge, and nobody re-reviewed the code after merge. An accepted-unfixed resolution is the decision owner's acceptance, not a fix. Manual and assistive-technology testing remains unmet and deferred to S1.0 (Decision 0022). This is not a hosted review of the original pull request, which had none.
expiry: Retained as historical R1 review evidence for the reviewed commit; a later code change needs a new review rather than an edit. Only the resolution of each finding is updated, by this tool.

findings.summary: Clearing a controlled temporal field shows the old value, and DateField and DatePicker submit it.
A required CheckboxGroup submits with nothing checked under the default native Form.
A single Escape closes the suggestions and also wipes the typed text.
Enter on an active suggestion submits the form with the typed text.
Items with a label but no value submit their array index.
A CheckboxGroup with a non-string label has no accessible name.
The open suggestion list is never exposed to assistive technology.
Setting errorMessage makes the field permanently invalid.
Server errors on TimeField and DateRangePicker do not clear when the user fixes the value.
NumberField hard-codes inputMode="decimal", hiding the minus key on iPhone.
Selecting a suggestion writes its value, not its label, into the visible input.
Missing proof for controlled values, required submission, Autocomplete keyboard, SearchField Escape, errorMessage, server-error clearing, and FormData.
SearchField Escape does not fire onClear.

resolution.reason: Known limitation accepted by Andrew for rc.1: the Autocomplete dismiss fix's blur check is proven only in Chromium.

findings.summary: The unmerged Autocomplete dismiss fix assumes Chromium behaviour.

notChecked: DatePicker and DateRangePicker calendar keyboard beyond the existing browser test
retentionPolicy: Content-addressed Git records retained in default-branch history; reviewer scratch files and agent transcripts are not retained

reviewer.access: read-only reviewer agent; no GitHub access; worktree left unchanged
reviewer.independence: a different model and harness from the Codex automation that produced the R1 code and pull requests
reviewer.kind: retroactive independent review of the current code
